name: import-config-dialog
opens_with: /import-config, then Enter on the first row
notes: The preview/confirm step behind import-config-picker. ENV: reaching it at all requires build_import_preview to succeed, which needs ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md — on a host without it the opener degrades to a status_message and the overlay never opens. The needle is the static instruction line, present whether or not the preview found content.
